title: edge-card model card data
description: card.json — the machine-readable source of truth for one converted model; CARD.md is rendered from it. Public, versioned API: stable names, no breaking renames after commit; schema 1.1 (Phase 6) added the additive `browser` block. This card is NOT a replacement for hand-written Hugging Face model cards — it is the structured superset their Performance tables are derivable from. The `delegation` block is filled directly from `edge-lint --json` output (lint_report.schema.json) and, per the version-axis rule, always carries the matrix snapshot's backend + litert_version. This phase formats and links measured data; it never produces measurements — all benchmark records carry `provenance`.

schema_version.description: 1.1 (Phase 6, additive): the optional `browser` block. 1.2 (Phase 13, additive): the optional `device` block. A card carrying `device` must declare 1.2; a card carrying `browser` declares 1.1 (or 1.2 when it also carries `device`); older documents without these blocks remain valid.

id.description: Catalog id; also the card's directory name under cards/.

benchmarks.description: Owner-measured records, verbatim from the ingested benchmark results file.

litert_version.description: The matrix snapshot's litert_version behind the lint verdicts — verdicts are only valid for this runtime version.

blocking_ops.description: Blocking op names in the lint report's impact ranking order, deduplicated.

matched_provenance_counts.description: From the lint report summary: measured- vs inferred-backed verdicts stay distinguishable on the card.

delegation.description: Filled directly from `edge-lint --json` output; null when no lint report was supplied.

cross_runtime.description: Comparative numbers on other runtimes; the benchmark record shape with `runtime` required.

pitfalls.description: Free-text list authored by the owner in meta.yaml — never generated.

browser.description: Browser (LiteRT.js) behavior, merged from a sweep result file (sweep_result.schema.json) by `edge-card enrich` — schema 1.1, Phase 6. Model-level facts ONLY: op-level matrix entries are never derived from these records (the trap rule). Backend record fields map 1:1 from the sweep file's backend records; the full record (failure_class, error, delegation_evidence, sweep config) stays in the linked sweep_source file.

backends.description: One record per backend attempted, sorted by backend id (carried from the sweep file).

demo_url.description: URL of this model's demo-zoo page (Phase 7); null until one exists. Preserved across re-enrichment.

sweep_source.description: Repo-relative path of the sweep result JSON these records came from.

device.description: On-device behavior (NPU and LiteRT-LM lanes), merged from device-run result files (device_run_result.schema.json) by `edge-card enrich --device-runs` — schema 1.2, Phase 13. Model-level facts ONLY: op-level matrix entries are never derived from these records (the trap rule, device edition). Each entry embeds the accelerator record verbatim (1:1, no reinterpretation) plus the snapshot file it came from.

records.description: One entry per (device x accelerator), sorted by (device, accelerator).

device_run_entry.description: One accelerator record from one device-run snapshot file, embedded verbatim.

device.description: Device slug (the snapshot file's <device> segment); the human-readable name is in run.env.device.

source.description: Repo-relative path of the device-run snapshot file this record came from.

browser_backend_record.description: One backend's sweep outcome; fields typed exactly as in sweep_result.schema.json (1:1 mapping, no reinterpretation).

output_match.description: Numerical comparison against the wasm_xnnpack reference; null for the reference itself or when comparison was impossible (see the sweep_source record).

latency_p50_ms.description: Only ever meaningful together with env — results are presented with the environment that produced them.

provenance.description: Same enum as the sweep record: example fixtures never masquerade as real model behavior.
